collection: new scene categories (Nov 2026) — 1 test clip per chip

clips.title: Eye to Moon
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, cool cinematic grade. Extreme close-up of a woman's eye in a dark bedroom, her iris catching faint window light. She blinks slowly and the circular iris dissolves seamlessly into a full moon at the identical position and scale, hanging over a silent pine forest. Thin wisps of cloud drift across the moon. Silver moonlight, deep blue shadows. Locked-off framing holding the circle dead center through the transition, 85mm. Shallow depth of field, fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Rooftop to Market
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, vibrant travel-film grade. A young man in a linen shirt stands on a quiet Lisbon rooftop at sunrise and turns his head sharply to the right. The camera whips with him into a streak of motion blur and lands mid-movement in a crowded Marrakech spice market at noon, the same man now walking forward through the stalls. Dust and colored spices fill the air. Soft dawn light snapping to hard midday sun. Fast whip pan right, 24mm. Motion blur on the whip, light grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Calm to Chaos
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, clean bright grade then gritty grade. A man sleeps peacefully in a sunlit white bedroom, curtains drifting in the breeze. Without warning the frame cuts hard to the same man, eyes wide, gripping the wheel of a speeding car at night in pouring rain, headlights strobing across his face. Rain hammers the windshield. Soft morning light slamming into harsh sodium streetlight. Locked-off, then frantic handheld, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, heavy grain on the second half, 24fps.

clips.title: Child to Elder
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, timeless, warm nostalgic grade. Close-up of a girl of about eight blowing out birthday candles in a dim kitchen. As the smoke curls up, her face morphs smoothly through the years, teenager, young woman, middle age, into an elderly woman blowing out candles in the same kitchen with the same expression. Smoke drifts through the frame. Warm candlelight throughout. Slow push-in, 85mm. Shallow depth of field, soft grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Summer Memory
clips.prompt: Live-action, early 2000s, faded home-movie grade. Two friends laugh on the tailgate of an old pickup beside a lake at sunset. An orange light leak blooms across the frame from the right, burning almost to white, and fades to reveal the same two friends years older sitting on a porch at dusk. Dust motes and lens bloom. Warm golden hour light. Gentle handheld drift, 35mm. Soft edges, heavy film grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Bus Wipe
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, crisp urban grade. A woman in a grey coat waits on a busy city sidewalk holding a coffee. A red bus passes close to the lens and fills the frame; as it clears, she is now in a yellow raincoat on a rainy cobbled European street holding an umbrella. Traffic, puddles, falling rain. Overcast daylight. Locked-off medium shot, 50mm. Motion blur on the bus, light grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Into the Window
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, cinematic night grade. Wide shot of a city apartment block at night with dozens of lit windows. The camera rushes toward one window, punches straight through the glass, and lands inside a cozy kitchen where a couple dances barefoot to a record player. Steam rises from a pot on the stove. Cool blue exterior to warm tungsten interior. Fast push-in through the window, 24mm. Seamless motion blur, light grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Endless Stairs
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, timeless, muted surreal grade. A man in a dark suit climbs a narrow spiral stone staircase inside an old tower, seen from directly above. As he reaches the top step, the framing lines up exactly with the bottom of the staircase where he began, so the clip loops perfectly. Dust drifts in shafts of light. Soft light from narrow arrow slits. Steady overhead slow rotation, 24mm. Deep focus, fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Water Balloon
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, bright summer grade. A water balloon bursts against a laughing boy's open palm in a sunny backyard, the water exploding into a glittering sphere of droplets that hang in the air. Grass blades sway, every droplet catches the sun. Hard backlit sunlight. Locked-off close-up, 100mm. Ultra slow motion, 1000fps feel, crisp detail.

clips.title: Skater Drop
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, punchy street grade. A skateboarder rolls fast toward the lip of a concrete bowl, ramps into slow motion as he launches into the air, board spinning beneath him at the peak, then snaps back to full speed as he lands and rolls away. Dust kicks up from the wheels. Hard late-afternoon sun. Low follow shot, 18mm. Motion blur at full speed, crisp at slow speed, 24fps.

clips.title: City Day to Night
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, clean cityscape grade. A locked-off rooftop view of a downtown skyline as the sun sets, clouds racing across the sky, shadows sweeping across buildings and windows lighting up one by one into a glittering night. Car light trails flow along the streets below. Golden hour fading to blue hour. Static locked-off, 35mm. Deep focus, time-lapse cadence.

clips.title: Through the Crossing
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, crisp urban grade. A hyperlapse moving forward across a giant city scramble crossing at dusk, crowds swirling in fast-motion streaks around the camera as it glides steadily across the intersection and into a lantern-lit alley. Neon signs flicker on as it moves. Blue hour with neon. Forward stabilized hyperlapse, 16mm. Smooth path, motion-blurred crowds, 24fps.

clips.title: Unbreaking Glass
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, clean studio grade. Shards of a wine glass and a pool of red wine on a marble floor fly backwards upward, reassembling into a perfect full glass that lands back in a woman's hand. Droplets stream back into the bowl. Soft key light on a dark background. Locked-off medium close-up, 85mm. Crisp, slow-motion reverse, 24fps.

clips.title: Caught Mid-Jump
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, warm film grade. Three friends burst out laughing and jump off a wooden dock into a lake at sunset; at the peak of the jump everything freezes mid-air, droplets suspended, while the camera keeps drifting slowly around them. Golden spray hangs frozen in the air. Warm golden hour backlight. Slow orbit around the frozen moment, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, film grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Clay Breakfast
clips.prompt: Clay animation, present day, warm cozy grade. A clay fried egg, toast and bacon assemble themselves on a plate in jerky stop-motion, the toast hopping out of a clay toaster and butter smearing itself across it. Visible thumbprints in the clay. Soft morning window light. Static overhead, macro. Handmade texture, 12fps stop-motion cadence.

clips.title: Hospital Corridor
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, clean clinical grade. Two doctors in scrubs walk briskly down a busy hospital corridor, talking intently, dodging a gurney and nurses as they go. Monitors glow, a clipboard changes hands. Cool fluorescent light with warm window patches. Steadicam leading them backwards, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Rooftop Chase
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, gritty action grade. A man in a dark hoodie sprints across rain-slick rooftops at night, leaping a gap between buildings while a pursuer closes in behind him. Rain sprays and gravel scatters under their feet. Hard sodium streetlight and flashes of lightning. Fast handheld tracking, 24mm. Motion blur, heavy grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Warehouse Brawl
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, desaturated gritty grade. Two fighters trade blows in an abandoned warehouse, one slamming the other into stacked wooden crates that splinter apart. Dust bursts and hanging chains sway. Hard top light through broken skylights. Handheld orbit, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, heavy grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Shape in the Fog
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, cold horror grade. A fisherman on a misty dock raises his lantern; the fog slowly parts to reveal a colossal dark shape rising from the black water behind him. Waves lap, fog swirls. Weak lantern light against grey fog. Slow pull back revealing the scale, 24mm. Deep focus, heavy grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Train Platform
clips.prompt: Live-action, 1940s, warm period grade. A steam train hisses into a crowded platform, steam rolling across the frame; a soldier in uniform steps down and scans the crowd for someone. Steam billows, porters push luggage carts. Shafts of light through the station roof. Slow push-in, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, film grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Kitchen Standoff
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, tense warm grade. Two brothers face each other across a kitchen table at night, one slamming his palm down, the other refusing to look away. A glass of water trembles on the table. A single pendant light throwing hard shadows. Slow push-in between them, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Rooftop Tango
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, romantic warm grade. A couple dances a passionate tango on a city rooftop at dusk, her red dress swirling as he spins her. Strings of lights sway above them. Golden hour fading to blue. Slow orbit around them, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Skyscraper Fall
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, vertigo grade. A man loses his grip on the edge of a skyscraper and falls backward, the city stretching far below him, jacket flapping. Loose papers whip past. Hard daylight. Top-down drop following him, 18mm. Deep focus, motion blur, 24fps.

clips.title: Bridge Blast
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, blockbuster grade. A jeep speeds across a wooden jungle bridge as the bridge erupts in a fireball behind it, debris raining into the river below. Birds scatter, flames roll upward. Hard sun and fire glow. Wide side tracking, 24mm. Motion blur, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: The Tunnel
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, 1960s, dirty period grade. A prisoner crawls out of a muddy tunnel into a rainy field beyond the prison walls, gasping, searchlights sweeping the sky behind him. Rain pours, mud splashes. Cold searchlight beams. Low handheld push, 28mm. Heavy grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Perfume Drop
clips.prompt: Luxury commercial, present day, sleek black-and-gold grade. An unbranded crystal perfume bottle rotates on a black mirrored surface as a single drop of golden liquid falls in slow motion and splashes into rings of ripples around it. Gold dust floats in the air. Hard rim light and a soft top key. Slow orbit, 100mm macro. Shallow depth of field, pristine finish, 24fps.

clips.title: Singer in the Rain
clips.prompt: Live-action, present day, moody neon grade. A singer in a long coat performs straight to camera on an empty street at night, rain pouring, neon reflections in the puddles, hair soaked. Steam rises from street grates. Pink and blue neon. Slow push-in, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: One Last Job
clips.prompt: Cinematic live-action, present day, steel-blue trailer grade. A grizzled man in a suit stands at a rain-streaked window overlooking a city at night and turns slowly to camera as a phone rings on the desk behind him. Rain runs down the glass. Cold city light, warm desk lamp. Slow push-in, 50mm anamorphic. Shallow depth of field, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Villa Approach
clips.prompt: Luxury commercial, present day, bright airy grade. A drone glides low over an infinity pool toward a modern white villa at sunset, sliding glass doors open, interior lights glowing warmly. Water ripples, palm fronds sway. Golden hour light. Drone fly-through toward the house, 24mm. Deep focus, crisp, 24fps.

clips.title: Latte Heart POV
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, warm cafe grade, vertical 9:16. POV of a barista's hands pouring steamed milk into an espresso, drawing a heart in latte art, then sliding the cup toward camera. Steam curls up. Soft window light. Static overhead POV, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, crisp, 30fps.

clips.title: Ink Bloom
clips.prompt: Minimalist, timeless, black-and-white grade. Black ink drops into clear water and blooms into swirling clouds that drift into abstract shapes against pure white, leaving clean negative space in the center for a title. Ink tendrils curl slowly. Soft even backlight. Locked-off, macro. Crisp, slow motion.

clips.title: Burger Build
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, appetizing warm grade. Ingredients drop one by one in slow motion onto a brioche bun: a sizzling patty, melting cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato, then the top bun with sesame seeds bouncing. Steam rises and sauce drips. Warm key with soft fill on a dark background. Slow push-in, 100mm. Shallow depth of field, slow motion.

clips.title: Silver Runway
clips.prompt: Luxury commercial, present day, high-fashion grade. A model in a flowing silver gown strides down a dark runway toward camera, fabric rippling with each step, camera flashes popping from the crowd. Haze hangs in the air. Hard top spotlight. Slow dolly back ahead of her, 85mm. Shallow depth of field, crisp, slow motion.

clips.title: Bus Stop
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, cool melancholy grade. A man without an umbrella sits alone at a city bus stop in heavy rain, water streaming off the shelter roof, cars hissing past through deep puddles. Rain ripples every surface. Cold streetlight and passing headlights. Slow push-in, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Moor Wanderer
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, 1800s, cold grey grade. A cloaked figure walks across a foggy moor toward a lone crooked tree, the fog so thick the edges of the world disappear. Long grass bends, fog drifts in layers. Flat diffused grey light. Slow push-in, 35mm. Deep haze, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: First Snow
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, soft cold grade. A little girl in a red coat looks up as the first snowflakes fall on a quiet village street at dusk, catching one on her tongue. Snow drifts down, warm windows glow behind her. Blue hour with warm window light. Slow crane down to her, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, soft grain, 24fps.

clips.title: The Wall of Dust
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, burnt-orange grade. A massive wall of dust rolls over a small desert town, swallowing buildings one by one as people run for cover. Debris tumbles down the street. Orange-filtered sun. Static wide, 35mm. Deep haze, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Jazz Club Haze
clips.prompt: Film noir live-action, 1950s, high-contrast grade. Smoke curls through a dim jazz club as a saxophonist plays under a single spotlight, the haze glowing in the beam. Patrons sit silhouetted at small tables. Hard spotlight cutting through smoke. Slow push-in, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Cathedral Beams
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, timeless, golden haze grade. Shafts of sunlight pour through stained glass into a hazy cathedral as a lone woman walks slowly down the aisle. Dust glows inside the beams. Hard window light through haze. Slow crane rise, 24mm. Deep focus, soft grain.

clips.title: Kelp Forest
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, deep teal grade. A free diver glides through a towering kelp forest, sunbeams dancing down through the water, a school of fish scattering around her. Bubbles rise toward the surface. Caustic sunlight from above. Slow tracking alongside, 24mm. Soft distance haze, 24fps.

clips.title: Mirage
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, bleached hot grade. A lone figure walks toward camera on a desert road through rippling heat shimmer, appearing to float on a mirage of water. The shimmer bends everything behind them. Hard noon sun. Locked-off telephoto, 300mm. Compressed perspective, heavy shimmer.

clips.title: The Note
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, moody warm grade. A handwritten note on a desk is sharp in the foreground; the focus racks to a woman standing frozen in the doorway behind it as she realizes what it says. Dust floats in the lamplight. Warm desk lamp. Static with a slow rack focus, 85mm. Very shallow depth of field.

clips.title: Market Lights
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, warm bokeh grade. A woman's face is in sharp focus at a night market while the background melts into creamy circles of string lights. She smiles slightly. Warm practical light. Slow push-in, 85mm at f/1.2. Extremely shallow depth of field.

clips.title: Toy Town Square
clips.prompt: Miniature-look tilt-shift, present day, saturated grade. A high view of a busy town square where people, cars and trams look like tiny toys, the top and bottom of the frame blurred away. Motion slightly sped up. Bright sun. Static high angle, tilt-shift lens. Crisp center band.

clips.title: Stair Set
clips.prompt: Live-action, 1990s, VHS skate-video grade. A skater in baggy jeans ollies down a set of concrete stairs with the fisheye lens inches from his board, the whole plaza bending around him, then lands and rolls past camera. Wheels clack on the landing. Hard sun. Handheld follow, 10mm fisheye. Distorted edges, VHS grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Bee at Work
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, natural summer grade. Extreme macro of a honeybee working the center of a sunflower, every hair on its body dusted with gold pollen as it crawls between the florets. Its wings flutter in short bursts and a grain of pollen drifts off. Warm late-afternoon sunlight. Slow push-in, 100mm macro. Razor-thin focus, soft creamy background, crisp detail, 24fps.

clips.title: Sunrise Run
clips.prompt: Cinematic live-action, present day, warm anamorphic grade. A runner crests a hill at sunrise, the sun behind her throwing long blue anamorphic flares across the frame. Her breath is visible in the cold. Golden backlight. Side tracking, 40mm anamorphic. Flares, grain.

clips.title: Speakeasy
clips.prompt: Live-action, 1920s, sepia-gold grade. Flappers in beaded dresses dance the Charleston in a crowded speakeasy as a jazz band plays on a tiny stage, champagne overflowing from coupes on the bar. Smoke haze hangs in the air. Warm practical light from table lamps. Slow crane up through the crowd, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, film grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Chrome Diner
clips.prompt: Live-action, 1950s, pastel Technicolor grade. Inside a gleaming chrome roadside diner, a cook in a white paper hat flips burgers on a sizzling grill while a glowing jukebox spins a record and customers in red vinyl booths sip milkshakes. Steam rises from the grill and a neon sign buzzes outside the window. Bright warm light with neon accents. Steadicam glide along the counter, 35mm. Saturated color, soft grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Arcade
clips.prompt: Live-action, 1980s, neon VHS grade. A group of teenagers in denim jackets crowds around glowing arcade cabinets, one slamming the buttons as the screen flashes and the others cheer him on. Neon tubes line the ceiling and coins clatter into trays. Pink and blue neon wash. Handheld push through the crowd, 28mm. VHS tracking lines, soft grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Gaslit Street
clips.prompt: Live-action, 1880s, cold foggy grade. A horse-drawn cab clatters down a cobbled London street at night as a lamplighter on a ladder ignites the gas lamps one by one. Fog rolls low along the ground and a figure in a top hat hurries past. Warm gaslight against cold blue fog. Slow dolly forward, 35mm. Deep haze, film grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Feast Hall
clips.prompt: Live-action, medieval era, warm firelit grade. A long feast hall erupts in cheers as a king raises his goblet, dogs fighting over bones beneath the tables and a great hearth fire roaring behind him. Smoke rises to the rafters. Firelight and candle glow. Slow push-in down the length of the table, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, film grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Drone Delivery
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, near future, clean optimistic grade. Delivery drones zip between glass towers covered in hanging gardens as a woman on a leafy balcony reaches up to receive a parcel from one. Rooftop farms and solar canopies stretch across the city. Soft daylight. Slow crane rise past her balcony, 35mm. Crisp detail, light grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Parking Garage
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, cold green grade. A woman walks to her car in an empty parking garage, keys in hand, as footsteps echo behind her; she stops and turns, and no one is there. Fluorescent tubes buzz overhead. Flickering fluorescent light. Slow tracking behind, 35mm. Grain.

clips.title: The Letter
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, soft natural grade. An elderly man sits alone at a kitchen table reading a handwritten letter, tears welling as he slowly sets it down and looks at an empty chair. Dust drifts in the window light. Soft window light. Static close-up, 85mm. Shallow depth of field, fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Over the Top
clips.prompt: Cinematic live-action, World War I, desaturated grade. At a whistle blast, soldiers climb ladders out of a muddy trench and charge across a cratered field through drifting smoke, explosions throwing up earth around them. Overcast grey light. Side tracking alongside the charge, 24mm. Motion blur, heavy grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Coffee Collision
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, bright warm grade. Two strangers in a hurry collide at a cafe doorway, both coffees splashing down their shirts, and after a stunned beat they both burst out laughing. Steam rises from the spilled cups and a barista freezes mid-pour behind them. Soft morning daylight. Static medium two-shot, 50mm. Shallow depth of field, light grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Empty Highway
clips.prompt: Cinematic live-action, near future, rust-and-dust grade. A lone survivor in a weathered coat walks with a scruffy dog between abandoned, rusting cars on an overgrown eight-lane highway, weeds bursting through the asphalt. Wind pushes tall grass and a torn billboard flaps. Hazy midday sun. Drone rising and pulling back to reveal the empty road, wide. Fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Aisle Seven
clips.prompt: Live-action photoreal, present day, sickly green grade. A survivor with a flashlight creeps down a dark, ransacked supermarket aisle as a figure at the far end slowly turns its head toward her. Cans roll across the floor and an overhead tube flickers on and off. Flickering fluorescent light and torch beam. Slow push-in, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, heavy grain, 24fps.

clips.title: Rooftop Landing
clips.prompt: Cinematic live-action, present day, blockbuster grade. An original masked hero in a charcoal armored suit drops onto a rooftop in a three-point landing, cracking the concrete, a long cape settling behind as she rises. City lights glitter far below and steam vents hiss. Cool moonlight with a warm city glow. Crane down into the landing, 35mm. Shallow depth of field, fine grain, 24fps.

clips.title: The Glance
clips.prompt: Documentary style, present day, flat office grade. An office manager stands at a whiteboard explaining an overly ambitious plan to a room of unimpressed coworkers, then pauses and glances awkwardly straight into the camera. A coworker slowly sips coffee. Flat fluorescent light. Handheld with a quick snap zoom onto his face, 35mm. Natural grain, 24fps.
